tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description: Replace the presented secret (POST /keys/rotate). Same id/caller_id and credits. New fdg_… is returned once. Old secret then fails 401 invalid_api_key. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias only. No ops file-edit.

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Invalidate the presented secret (POST /keys/revoke). Same id is revoked; old secret then fails 401 invalid_api_key. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias only. No ops file-edit.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Prepaid TEST packs (GET /credits/packs). checkout_credits is intent only; credits grant after confirm_credits.

tools.name: checkout_credits
tools.description: TEST intent for a pack (POST /credits/checkout). Intent only, returns credits_pending; credits are not granted or spendable until confirm_credits succeeds. Requires a caller key. No live Stripe.

tools.name: confirm_credits
tools.description: Confirm a TEST checkout intent (POST /credits/confirm). This is when credits become granted/spendable (appends credit.purchase with credits_added). TEST only. Synthetic pi_test_… until LAS-212.

tools.name: quote_credits
tools.description: Dry-run cost for an op without debit (GET /credits/quote?op=digest). Returns cost, balance, and would_succeed.

tools.name: credit_balance
tools.description: Derived prepaid balance for this caller_id (GET /credits/balance).

tools.name: credit_events
tools.description: Append-only events for this caller_id (GET /credits/events). Debit reason is digest_success after POST /digest ok:true.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: issue_key, credit_events, digest_feed · Private data: issue_key, verify_key, rotate_key, revoke_key · Public sink: issue_key, rotate_key, revoke_key, checkout_credits, confirm_credits, credit_events, digest_feed · Destructive: quote_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: issue_key, credit_events, digest_feed · Private data: issue_key, verify_key, rotate_key, revoke_key · Public sink: issue_key, rotate_key, revoke_key, checkout_credits, confirm_credits, credit_events, digest_feed · Destructive: quote_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
